'If you've controlled an Agility token this turn, create an Agility token, then repeat for Confidence, Might, Toughness, and Vigor.'

Go again is NOT authored: it is an UNCONDITIONAL printed keyword (printed_keywords carries GoAgain and the text gates nothing on it), so it comes from the card DB - re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. Note the contrast with Battlefield Blitz: because no GAIN GO_AGAIN ability exists here, loader.conditional_keywords() returns empty and the DB keyword stays unconditional, which is correct for this card.

THE GATE - why EVENT_THIS_TURN(create, <slug>) equals 'you've controlled an X token this turn': all five stat tokens destroy themselves at their controller's start of turn (agility/confidence/might/vigor trigger START_OF_TURN, toughness START_OF_ANY_TURN - read directly in json/tokens/*.json), so a token created on an earlier turn cannot survive into the action phase of this one. In every reachable state, 'controlled an X at some point this turn' therefore collapses to 'created an X this turn'. create_token writes did_this_turn:create:<slug> per token against the creating player, alongside subtype/type qualifiers (effect_keywords.py:411-421), and EVENT_THIS_TURN with qualifier reads exactly that marker for SELF (condition_types.py:1042-1084). This satisfies the release note 'regardless of if you currently control a token with that name' for free - the gate is creation-based, not current-state.

RESIDUAL GAP, stated plainly: the printed condition also covers GAINING control of a matching token this turn without creating it. No condition reads that (CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE was considered as the current-control half of an OR and rejected on two counts: it answers only the present, and it scans permanents plus equipment slots while these Aura-subtype tokens live in the auras zone - condition_types.py:1728-1742 - so it could never see them). No control-change effect touches these tokens anywhere in the corpus, so the gap is unreachable today; if one is ever added, this gate needs revisiting.

Structure: five independent CONDITIONAL_EFFECTs in printed order (Agility, Confidence, Might, Toughness, Vigor), each with its own gate - 'then repeat' makes each repetition self-gated, and effects in one ability resolve in order. The release note that replacement effects apply to EACH token creation holds automatically: each CREATE_TOKEN routes through the canonical create_token, where replacements intercept. No priority between the creations needs authoring - sequential resolution within one ability is the engine's behaviour.

All types/params verified against handlers: CONDITIONAL_EFFECT reads when/then (effect_types.py:3633-3660; 'when', never 'conditions'), CREATE_TOKEN reads token/amount (1890-1961), tokens exist as json/tokens/{agility,confidence,might,toughness,vigor}.json with slug-matching filenames. No known gaps beyond the control-change clause above.
